svg.aria-label: Fifteen flagship projects by Harkirat Singh Saggar

g.text: 01 / VALENS & CYBERSHIELD AI
Autonomous cyber-deception platform for real-time MITRE ATT&CK correlation.
Deploys canary tokens, automated WAF quarantine, and RAG-powered incident response.
PYTHON · FASTAPI · MITRE ATT&CK · WEBSOCKETS · CYBERSECURITY
02 / AI TICKET ANALYZER
Automated customer support ticket classification and sentiment scoring engine.
Extracts intent, urgency level, and categorizes queries for intelligent automated triage.
PYTHON · NLP · SCIKIT-LEARN · FASTAPI · PYDANTIC
03 / DECODE NEURAL NETWORKS
Neural networks built entirely from scratch using pure NumPy and linear algebra.
Every forward pass, loss, backpropagation, and gradient coded by hand and verified.
PYTHON · NUMPY · MATHEMATICS · DEEP LEARNING
04 / LSTM NEXT WORD PREDICTOR & FROM SCRATCH
Recurrent sequence modeling for character and word prediction tasks.
Implements gating mechanisms, hidden state recurrence, and sequence generation.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · KERAS · LSTM · NLP
05 / ENCODER-DECODER ARCHITECTURE
Sequence-to-sequence neural architecture for transforming structured series.
Explores latent representation bottleneck and state transfer across RNN / LSTM layers.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · KERAS · SEQ2SEQ
06 / VISUALISING CNN & LENET-5
Deep convolutional networks with layer activations and feature map visualization.
Inspects convolutional filter responses, spatial hierarchies, and receptive fields.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · OPENCV · CNN · COMPUTER VISION
07 / CATS VS DOGS & TRANSFER LEARNING
Image classification using modern CNN architectures and pretrained models.
Implements data augmentation, fine-tuning feature extractors, and regularization.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · KERAS · TRANSFER LEARNING
08 / HYPERPARAMETER TUNING
Systematic neural network hyperparameter optimization using Keras Tuner.
Compares RandomSearch, Hyperband, and Bayesian strategies for optimal convergence.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · KERAS TUNER · OPTIMIZATION
09 / IMPROVING NEURAL NETWORKS
Generalization techniques: dropout, batch normalization, and weight decay.
Empirical studies on vanishing/exploding gradients and loss surface stabilization.
PYTHON · TENSORFLOW · KERAS · REGULARIZATION
10 / PRESCRIPTION-AI
AI-assisted medical prescription analysis with OCR and LLM-powered extraction.
Structures handwritten dosages, instructions, and interactive patient safety chat.
PYTHON · FASTAPI · OCR · LLM · HEALTHCARE AI
11 / FASTAPI & PYDANTIC MICROSERVICES
High-concurrency microservice layer for serving machine learning models.
Production schemas, asynchronous endpoints, request validation, and OpenAPI specs.
PYTHON · FASTAPI · PYDANTIC · UVICORN · REST API
12 / CREDIT CARD CHURN PREDICTION
End-to-end customer churn classification on complex financial tabular data.
Feature engineering, imbalance handling (SMOTE), and model benchmark comparison.
PYTHON · SCIKIT-LEARN · PANDAS · CLASSIFICATION
13 / PCA USE CASE & SVM KERNELS
Dimensionality reduction and non-linear classification boundary experiments.
Evaluates variance retention, projection planes, and RBF / Polynomial kernel spaces.
PYTHON · SCIKIT-LEARN · PCA · SVM · DATA SCIENCE
14 / RUVIEW SPATIAL INTELLIGENCE
Translates commodity WiFi signal distortions into real-time spatial analytics.
Presence detection and vital sign monitoring without any camera hardware or video.
PYTHON · SIGNAL PROCESSING · MACHINE LEARNING · IOT
15 / SILHOUETTE CLUSTERING & UNSUPERVISED ML
Unsupervised clustering evaluation and optimal cluster separation diagnostics.
Calculates silhouette coefficients to identify cohesive clusters and density boundaries.
PYTHON · SCIKIT-LEARN · KMEANS · CLUSTERING
